verdict.rationale: Restate has durable timers and delayed messages that the docs say can be used to implement patterns like cron jobs. That makes recurring schedules a build-it-yourself pattern rather than a native scheduler. The CLI and Introspection SQL API can list invocations and their status, but there is no explicit evidence of viewing upcoming scheduled runs. Missing for 10: native cron-expression schedules, overlap policies, schedule pause/resume, explicit visibility into upcoming runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
